image_title: Improvement Comparison of TTRL and T³RL
summary: This bar chart titled 'Improvement Comparison of TTRL and T³RL' illustrates the percentage improvement across different math levels (MATH-L1 to MATH-L5) for two methods: TTRL (shown in gray) and T³RL (shown in red). The data points indicate that MATH-L1 achieved a significant improvement of 275% with an additional gain of +0.8%, while MATH-L2 showed a 225% improvement with +0.5%. MATH-L3, MATH-L4, and MATH-L5 had improvements of 230%, 240%, and 250% respectively, with additional gains of +6.3%, +6.7%, and +8.9%. The chart highlights a trend of increasing additional gains as the math levels progress, particularly for T³RL, which shows a steady upward trend in performance. The vertical axis represents improvement percentage, while the horizontal axis lists the math levels.
